description: Learning-plane benchmark task set (issue #144). Changing a task, a seed, a hidden test, a planned tier, verify.py or meshloop.toml requires a new version and a new baseline. lp-3 supersedes lp-2 (integrity hardening): verify.py tests only the pristine seed plus the task's editable files plus the hidden tests, in an isolated interpreter, and py-calc's ban on eval/exec/compile/__import__ also covers aliases, lookups by name and imports of builtins, importlib and ast.
